item.title: Trump halts strikes on Iran, says deal outline reached; US urges citizens to leave Middle East
item.description: US President Donald Trump said Saturday that he had canceled planned strikes on Iran after being asked by Iran and other Middle Eastern countries to hold off, claiming that the "perimeters of a deal" had been agreed to. item.title: EU holds emergency meeting as Ceuta migrant crisis death toll rises to 72
item.description: The European Union has called an emergency video conference of interior ministers for Tuesday after an estimated 50,000 to 60,000 migrants entered Spain’s North African enclave of Ceuta over a three-day period, leaving at least 72 people dead. item.title: Russian missile attack kills nine in Kyiv as Zelensky warns air defenses overwhelmed
item.description: A Russian missile and drone barrage struck Kyiv before dawn on Saturday, killing at least nine people and wounding more than 30, Ukrainian officials said. item.title: Sharp Acceleration in Global Warming Detected by Scientists
item.description: Global warming has shifted into a faster gear, with the planet warming at about 0.35°C per decade over the past ten years compared to just under 0.2°C per decade from 1970 to 2015, according to a new analysis from the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK). item.title: Dodgers acquire two-time Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal in blockbuster trade with Tigers
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired two-time reigning American League Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal from the Detroit Tigers late Saturday night in a blockbuster trade ahead of the Aug. 3 trade deadline. item.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russian oil refineries and Wildberries warehouse, killing eight
item.description: Ukrainian drones struck multiple oil refineries and a Wildberries e-commerce warehouse across Russia overnight, killing at least eight people, regional governors said on Saturday. item.description: At least three people were killed and 21 others injured Saturday evening when a homemade explosive device detonated at the entrance of an upscale Italian restaurant in central Moscow, Russian authorities said.
